visualCharacteristics.summary: Carousel of service boxes (icon, title, sentence, text link)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Garage services carousel — prev/next arrows (>= 1200px) and a "1 / N" counter above a strip of grey service boxes (3-up at >= 768px with the next one peeking, 1-up below, swipeable); the active box is 40px taller. Each box: 40px icon, display-bold title, text, dark-blue underlined text link. The carousel head (`<h4>` + subtext, optional head link) is default content before the block and is reabsorbed
visualCharacteristics.differsFromBase: news-cards carousel chrome and card text structure match; cards carry a 40px icon (home carousel cards have none).
visualCharacteristics.layout: horizontal strip bleeding into the right gutter
visualCharacteristics.interaction: prev/next buttons, swipe; counter derived from state
